plugin.name: Mahua Novels
plugin.description: A multi-agent novel studio: a deterministic engine keeps the schedule, three agents write, review and arbitrate.
view.studio.label: Mahua Novels
view.activation.label: Mahua Novels credential
view.activation.description: Check or replace the studio credential
studio.title: Mahua Novels
studio.header.title: {{title}}
rail.title: Books
board.title: Chapters
board.empty: No chapters planned yet. Ask the architect to plan an arc.
reason.targetReached: The committed count reached the target. Finalize the book.
reason.briefMissing: The brief is still open: genre, premise, target length and voice sample.
reason.noArcYet: No arc is planned yet. Plan the first one from chapter {{chapter}}.
reason.arcUncovered: Chapter {{chapter}} is not inside any planned arc yet. Plan one that covers it.
reason.arcEnded: The chapter just committed closed its arc. Write the arc summary and seal it.
reason.chapterAwaitingDraft: Chapter {{chapter}} has an outline but no prose.
reason.chapterBlocked: Chapter {{chapter}} was judged not fit to commit.
reason.chapterAwaitingReview: Chapter {{chapter}} has prose but no review.
reason.belowPass: Chapter {{chapter}} scored {{score}}, below the {{pass}} pass line.
reason.readyToCommit: Chapter {{chapter}} scored {{score}} and meets the commit bar.
reason.pointerDrift: The progress pointer disagrees with the chapter record. Re-align from the record.
reader.title: Chapter {{chapter}}
reader.blank: This chapter has no prose yet.
activation.title: Activate the studio
activation.body: Paste a credential to unlock writing. The bundled community credential is used automatically when you have not activated one.
activation.honest: The check runs offline: the signature proves the credential was issued by us, not that the person holding it bought it. It gates this plugin's own tools only.
activation.reason.malformed: That does not look like a Mahua Novels credential.
activation.reason.unknownKey: The credential was signed with a key this build does not trust.
activation.reason.signature: The signature does not match the content.
activation.reason.entitlement: This credential does not include the studio entitlement.
newBook.title: New book
newBook.name: Title
agent.architect.name: Mahua Writing Team Architect
agent.architect.description: Owns structure: brief, volume plan, arcs and chapter outlines.
agent.writer.name: Mahua Writing Team Writer
agent.writer.description: Drafts and revises chapter prose from the stored outline.
agent.editor.name: Mahua Writing Team Editor
agent.editor.description: Reviews chapters on seven dimensions and decides whether one is fit to commit.
agent.arbiter.name: Mahua Writing Team Arbiter
agent.arbiter.description: Rules on premise conflicts, deadlocks and author overrides, and records the ruling.
team.studio.name: Mahua Writing Team
team.studio.description: A novel studio: architect plans, writer drafts, editor judges, arbiter rules, the engine keeps progress.
team.studio.architect: Turns the brief into volumes, arcs and one-line chapter outlines.
team.studio.writer: Writes one chapter at a time from the stored outline and revises against must-fix items.
team.studio.editor: Scores seven dimensions and blocks any chapter that is not fit to commit.
team.studio.arbiter: Resolves premise conflicts, deadlocks and author overrides with a recorded ruling.
studio.handoff: Mahua Writing Team on “{{title}}” ({{phase}}). Next task: {{task}} for chapter {{chapter}}. Use the mahua_* tools, one step per call, and ask me before structural changes.
studio.handoffSent: Handed the next step to the chat.
studio.handoffFailed: Could not hand the next step to the chat.
studio.handoffNoWorkspace: No workspace folder is open. Open one so the chat has a working directory.
roster.label: Studio
invite.architect: {{member}}: take a look at "{{title}}" ({{phase}}, chapter {{chapter}}). Plan the next arc and tell me what changes.
invite.writer: {{member}}: write chapter {{chapter}} of "{{title}}". Read the context pack first and keep the chapter's outline promise.
invite.editor: {{member}}: review chapter {{chapter}} of "{{title}}". Run the deterministic checks before you judge.
invite.arbiter: {{member}}: settle what is pending on "{{title}}" before we write chapter {{chapter}}.
invite.noBook: {{member}}: we have no book in the studio yet. Help me set one up.

composer.empty.body: Start with a title, a genre and one sentence of premise. The architect takes it from there.
composer.newBookPrompt: Mahua Novels: let us start a new book. Ask me for the title, the genre and the premise, then set up the foundation before planning any chapter.
